# Free My PDF

> Free client-side PDF toolkit: unlock password-protected PDFs, edit text, and add digital signatures — all processed in the browser, nothing uploaded.

Free My PDF is a privacy-first web app for common PDF tasks. Every operation runs 100% in the user's browser using pdf-lib and pdfjs-dist, so files never leave the device.

## Pages

- [Unlock PDF](/): Remove password protection from PDF files instantly, client-side.
- [PDF Editor](/editor): Edit text, add whiteout, shapes, images, and annotations directly in the browser.
- [PDF Compressor](/compress): Reduce PDF file size in the browser with adjustable quality.
- [PDF Merger](/merge): Combine multiple PDFs into a single document, with drag-and-drop reordering.
- [PDF Splitter](/split): Split a PDF into individual pages or extract custom page ranges, delivered as a ZIP.
- [Image to PDF](/image-to-pdf): Convert and combine JPG, PNG, and WebP images into a single PDF with A4/Letter/auto-fit page sizing.
- [Image Compressor](/image-compress): Shrink JPG, PNG, and WebP images with adjustable quality, dimension caps, and format conversion.
- [Image Upscaler](/image-upscale): Enlarge images 2x-8x with progressive resampling and detail enhancement, fully in-browser.
- [Passport Photo Maker](/passport-photo): Crop photos to passport/visa sizes (2x2 in, 35x45 mm and more), set a background, and export a single photo or printable 4x6 sheet.
- [PDF Signature](/signature): Verify existing digital signatures or add your own signature to a PDF.
